posts.headline: Nineteen straight editions of dead air from One Nut Barner, and Put it in Ra's league-best 20-8 record now has TWO cracks in it after a follow-up 0-1 puts the 1.5 average finish on real notice.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and best-in-league 1.5 average finish demanded a statement Week 2 — instead adambarner111 says nothing while his contender tag starts looking like paper.

posts.headline: Sasinci is 0-1 through two weeks of scrutiny and Big Head can't find the scoreboard — 101.6 points last week was a warning shot, and the title banner is now legitimately in jeopardy.
posts.detail: A 13-15 career record and 5.5 average finish were already shaky pedigree — back-to-back low-scoring weeks are turning Megamind's crown into a punchline.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh is somehow still unbeaten, but 120.4 points remains the third-lowest total in the league and nobody with a 4-10, dead-last résumé gets the benefit of the doubt this fast.
posts.detail: One win doesn't erase a career 0.286 win pct and a 12th-place finish — the untalented tenth is still auditioning for real respect.

posts.headline: Thicks is 1-0 again, but 138.94 points last week was the league's lowest winning score — a title team with a 14-14 career record and 5.5 average finish should be shouting, not tiptoeing.
posts.detail: Tyrique14 has one ring and a mediocre overall résumé to show for it; a real contender doesn't sneak by, they stomp.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT posted a league-worst 72.02 points in Week 1, and the Ultimate Light Skin's biblical judgment is only getting started for a team with a shaky 13-14-1 career mark.
posts.detail: Eli's own catchphrase is coming for him — when your Week 1 output is the worst in the league, that's not a test of faith, that's straight fire and brimstone.
